import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings_files/"
access_token = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJmaWxlX3N5c3RlbSthZC5ibGFja2J1cm5AZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.s7U9wjne6ShDPsxno0m7C8e9uI-dV_SirrlM-PON2Do"

    filename = os.path.basename(file)
    # Split by '__' to separate date and rest
    if '__' not in filename:
        continue
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest into file_name and extension
    if '.' not in rest:
        continue
    file_name, extension = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    # Construct new directory and new filename
    new_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, file_name)
    new_filename = f"{date_part}.{extension}"
    source_file_path = os.path.join(base_dir, filename)

        source_file_path=source_file_path,
        destination_file_path=destination_file_path,
        access_token=access_token,
        overwrite=True,
        retain_dates=True
    )
